evidence: The gemma slugs answer 429 on every click, so OpenRouter is rate limiting the account and each attempt has to wait out the upstream limiter before moving on.
why_it_was_missed: The free tier is oversubscribed at that hour. The provider list needs more free models on it so a throttled slug is not the last one standing.
does_not_fix: Nothing much - once the account is topped up and the rate limit clears, Share and Review answer normally again.
